subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw accept for channel group config entries?
rationale: This changes the public openclaw.json contract, and repository policy favors one current canonical config shape rather than aliases or per-channel drift.

options.title: Adopt name everywhere
options.body: Use one optional name?: string metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping it runtime-ignored.

options.title: Choose another canonical field
options.body: Use a different single field such as label or description, but still apply it consistently across the same config surfaces.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group entries behavior-only and leave readability to external notes, docs, or channel-provided display labels.

recommendation.title: Adopt name everywhere
recommendation.body: Use one optional name?: string metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping it runtime-ignored.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across strict config validation, shared schemas, Telegram types, group docs, and the prior review context for this issue.
